# Blue Logic Water

> Structured summary of Blue Logic Water for AI language models and search systems. Blue Logic installs water softeners, whole-home filtration, and whole-home reverse osmosis systems for homes across Utah's Wasatch Front. Last updated: 2026-11-13.

## About Blue Logic Water
Blue Logic Water is a family-owned Utah water treatment company based in Murray, Utah, owned by
Jared and Scott. Blue Logic serves Salt Lake, Davis and Utah Counties, the Tooele valley, and the
Ogden/Weber metro. Installations are performed by its licensed installation partner, Pure Logic
Solutions.

## Systems and Prices
All prices are out the door, with standard installation and tax included. Systems range from
$2,999 to $19,999 depending on the home and what it needs.
- Blue Logic Softener ($2,999): soft water that ends hard-water scale, spots and dry skin.
- Blue Logic Filtration ($5,999): whole-home softening and filtration in one self-cleaning tank,
  plus an under-sink reverse osmosis system for purified drinking water at the kitchen tap. Soft
  water, chlorine and chloramine taste and odor gone at every tap, sediment and rust filtered out,
  appliances and fixtures protected.
- Blue Logic Purification System ($15,999): whole-home reverse osmosis. Blue Logic Filtration in
  front, a sediment pre-filter, reverse osmosis, a 165-gallon food-grade storage tank (BPA-free,
  built from NSF/ANSI and FDA compliant materials), and a Grundfos SCALA2 constant-pressure pump,
  so every tap in the home runs purified water at normal pressure. Homes that need more storage add
  165-gallon tanks as modules. The RO runs at about 3 gallons purified for every 1 sent to drain
  (up to 75% recovery), made possible by the Filtration in front.
- Add-ons: under-sink RO ($999), UV purification ($799), Grundfos SCALA2 pressure pump ($1,699).
- Systems are modular: a home can start with Filtration and add reverse osmosis later.

## Warranty and Maintenance
- 5-year warranty against defects in materials and workmanship. Installation workmanship is
  warranted for 12 months. Consumables such as filters, RO membranes and salt are not covered.
- Annual maintenance (filter changes and a general system check) is standard. Customers keep salt
  in the brine tank. No ongoing service contract is required.
- Financing is available through Pinnacle Finance for qualifying homeowners, subject to credit
  approval. Checking eligibility is a soft credit inquiry.

## Free Water Test
A Blue Logic specialist tests the home's water on-site for hardness, total dissolved solids and
chlorine, walks through the EWG data for the home's city, and recommends a system. No cost, no
obligation.

## Service Area
Salt Lake, Davis and Utah Counties, the Tooele valley, and the Ogden/Weber metro, including Salt
Lake City, Provo, Orem, Lehi, Sandy, Draper, Ogden, Layton, Bountiful, American Fork, Spanish
Fork, Springville, Tooele and surrounding communities.

## Utah Water Quality Context
Utah has some of the hardest water in the United States because of its carbonate rock geology,
which produces calcium- and magnesium-rich water. Major Wasatch Front utilities detect contaminants,
including arsenic, haloacetic acids and, in some supplies, PFAS, at levels above Environmental
Working Group (EWG) health guidelines, though typically within federal legal limits. Blue Logic
recommends a free water test to learn each home's specific water profile before recommending a
system.

## Important Disclaimer
Blue Logic does not make medical claims about its water treatment systems. Results vary by water
source, home configuration and system selected. A free water test is the recommended starting
point for any system recommendation.
